runs.name: main-reset-confirmation-regression
runs.coverage: Real main-page reset replaced visitor data, restored seed settings, and rendered an unchecked confirmation with a disabled button.

coverage: All 25 registered non-Hobby product pages rendered with Streamlit AppTest; home and about were also checked.
Manual study entry, duplicate submission, previewed edit and delete, timer start/pause/save, fixed demo-day timestamps.
Today plan, note creation, flashcard creation, diary, sleep/condition and exercise forms saved into visitor A only.
Roadmap JSON preview/import, settings and full CSV/ZIP export used the active visitor store.
Parallel visitor defaults, cross-visitor and shared-seed access fences, reset, TTL, forged handles, quotas and lock-cache lifecycle.
Google client construction, credential-vault access, authorized transport and disconnect were blocked before external access.
The real main-page reset was rechecked after changing confirmation widget identities; the checkbox and button returned to their initial visible states.
limitations: Local runtime verification was performed on Windows with Python 3.11.4 and Streamlit 1.57.0; it is not a Linux execution test.
The live symbolic-link test was skipped because the Windows account lacks creation privilege.
This report does not verify deployment of the updated Web experience to Community Cloud; browser and Cloud checks are recorded separately.
Hobby media conversion/transcription/OCR and real Google authentication or transmission are outside this Web experience.
